name: Happy Helloween
author: Addicting Games
description: Happy Halloween is a Halloween-themed cute and casual online game. The objective of this game is simple: catch the falling candies in your box without dropping a single one. It’s a weird and creepy night when suddenly Halloween candy starts falling from the sky. A small child dressed as a cute pumpkin while eerie music plays in the background runs back and forth in a frantic trying to catch all the Halloween candies. There are all kinds of lollipops that your character will enjoy as he rushes to grab them. You must help him out as you see the candies falling making sure he’s there before it hits the ground. While this has a Halloween theme, it’s not at all scary. If anything, it’s a cute and simple casual game for you to enjoy. Beat your own score every time you play as you climb up the leaderboards.
